context: Yuki and Mei catch up briefly at a café. Both growing in their careers.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: メイちゃん、お久しぶり！元気にしてた？
lines.en: Mei-chan, it's been forever! How have you been?
lines.style: Bright, genuine delight at reunion. Quick warmth on the opening, like genuine surprise at seeing someone missed. Soft throughout—no performance, just real affection.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ゆきちゃん、元気だよ。仕事も、結婚生活も、楽しい。
lines.en: I've been good, Yuki-chan. Work and married life—both really fun.
lines.style: Calm certainty with underlying contentment. Slight lift on 楽しい—not bragging, just sharing what's true. Soft eye contact in the voice. Inviting her to be part of the good thing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: よかった。私も、新しい部署で、毎日、頑張ってる。
lines.en: I'm so glad. I'm in a new department now, working hard every day.
lines.style: Honest echo of her own effort. The 'working hard' lands as vulnerable admission, not complaint. Pace steady but warm—matching her openness with her own small truth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: すごい！お互い、頑張ろうね。
lines.en: That's amazing! Let's both keep going, okay?
lines.style: Gentle affirming tone. Light lift on 'amazing'—she means it. The 'let's both keep going' lands as a soft promise, not pressure. Warmth that includes rather than celebrates.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今度、また、ゆっくりお話しよう。
lines.en: Next time let's take our time and really talk.
lines.style: Soft closing note that extends rather than ends. Slow pace, almost lingering. Not goodbye—just 'until next time.' Warmth that settles in the trailing off.
